searchText: > Withdrawal credentials aren't used for voluntary exits, it requires a signed message from the validator key this makes staking services a bit trickier. Customers can't exit if a staking service doesn't uphold their end of the deal since only the validator key (controlled by the staking service) can be used to exit voluntarily. so the customer has to wait until they get ejected if a staking-service is deliquent <@!690731283944570931> there has been a discussion about this on the eth2.0-specs github. An immediate solution is to provide the staker with a pre-signed voluntary exit transaction. Interesting Would users pre sign this transaction during the deposit flow? Staking services would provide the transaction. Of course, getting it to the staker safely may be a challenge
